aggregate_window: 120s reserved after export for the aggregate phase.
export_window: 900s reserved after the science stop point for evidence/export, judged by actual completion rather than elapsed time alone.
inflight_stop_policy: At science_deadline_seconds stop starting new science steps. A still-running step is either stopped with confirmed termination or retained by reference and reconciled in the export window; it is never reported complete.
lsf_choice: not selected: no bsub/bjobs/bhosts, LSF_ENVDIR or configured test node exists

payable_task_count.source: C plan W9 DA lane: one main chain, candidate TS <= 3, total tasks <= 12, wall clock <= 4h

per_phase_timing_baseline.note: Measured on the frozen P1 candidate 77ac1de for tiny H2/STO-3G Local steps. The optimize step dominates; the DA slice is larger, so the science window is not derived by scaling these rows alone.

queue_accounting: Local queue wait is 0s and is included in the same cumulative window. If LSF were selected, queue wait would count against science_deadline_seconds; it does not get a separate budget.
rule: A valid staged run reads one shared run-spec; a phase never resets started_at. A missing C24a leaves started_at null instead of inventing a science clock.
started_at_binding_rule: Set once at the first C24a-approved submit. Every phase (da-submit, da-evidence, aggregate) reads this same value; the readiness attempt does not start the science clock.
timeout_rule: An unset ACP2_DA_TIMEOUT is a usage error and never a silent default.
